profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee
profile.summary:
11+ years of IT Industry experience in providing User Interface & User Experience Design and Development
with most usable enterprise-wide applications.

Extensive Experience in Front-End Web Development with an eye for design and attention to detail, with a grasp
of HTML/HTML5, DHTML, XHTML, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax, Angular JS, ADA Compliance, Microsoft
SharePoint, CMS, and JSON.

Keep improving advanced development technique and developing technical skills and knowledge in technologies
like Azure, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, Unit Testing in JavaScript and Rest Services.

Expert in develop web pages for different devices like Mobile, Tablet and Desktop using RWD and Twitter
Bootstrap.

Responsible for checking cross browser compatibility, Responsive Web design and hence worded on different
browsers like Safari, Firefox, Google Chrome, and Internet Explorer.

Good exposure in Template/Theme Integration or Customization, WordPress Plugin Customization, Responsive web design/development, Bootstrap and Foundation Framework and writing JavaScript and jQuery code.

Experience in performing unit testing, performance testing for the Website, writing SQL Query and creating
Table and Index.

Developed HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the Store/Event Locator module using google maps JavaScript API V3 for
website, mobile and iPad. Utilized jQuery/JSON to populate content.

Implemented a responsive style jQuery carousel and performed Cross Browser compatibility testing.

Responsible for writing CSS and HTML without using WYSIWYG editors and used JavaScript for client-side
validations also used DHTML for menu and text effects on the website.

Expertise in Angular JS controllers, directives, factory and service resources, routings, and events.

Leveraged AngularJS resources for all data access, encapsulating URLs, and standardizing data access interfaces.

Created custom directives for re-usable components (multi-field form elements, background file uploads, etc.)

Implemented AngularJS Controllers to maintain each view data. Implemented Angular Service calls using
Angular Factory.

Expertise in DOM manipulation using JavaScript, jQuery, and Angular JS.

Experience in SASS / LESS CSS Preprocessors.

Experience in Production support tools like Splunk, New Relic, Jira, Confluence, WIKI, Pager Duty, Remedy etc.

Expertise in troubleshooting and analysis the production issue of various core applications and native
applications.

Perform all tests on production applications, prepare recovery procedures for all applications, and provide
upgrade to it.
